eventHelpers.name: Ghost Gallery & Crypt
steps: Find ghosts hiding in furniture with your pet, then use the blaster to defeat the Ghost Gallery boss.
Crypt: daily tasks award 4 Rusty Keys; defeating the Ghost Gallery boss awards 1. Clear 4 Crypt levels for Mummy Spider.
Nest: place 8 Twigs, then Jacobin Pigeon costs 4,000 Candy Corn.

eventHelpers.name: Hauntlet 2 & Poltergeist Box
steps: Stay on the same path as friends to remain together. Room items help everyone in that room.
Phone: Bolt always lies; avoid following the arrow. Rainbow Wand clears all ghosts in the room.
Keys unlock paths; Golden Keys match doors. Heart Potion heals; Golden Heart adds a heart; Ghost Potion protects for one door.
Find the Lightning Lever in the Crypt to access Skelicorn. Poltergeist Box odds: Bubblegeist 4%, Bobageist 20%, Caramelgeist 76%.

eventHelpers.name: Stitches’ Spotlight
steps: Collect Candy Corn around the tent; the spotlight removes collected Candy Corn when it catches you.
Use both platform levels and cover behind target boards. Stitches can knock the boards down.
Help the noisy hotel guests settle using items from the Crypt before taking Shoebill home.
